title: For those of you wondering what’s up with some of this apparently unrelated music stuff… I’m working on a way of authenticating real people in the community… at the moment live music still seems to be safe from ai/chat-bots.

classification.theory_summary: Proposes using live music as a verification/authentication method on Discord to distinguish real people from AI/chat-bots; suggests music can help communicate ineffable ideas beyond text.
classification.skip_reason: No dream narrative, locations, spatial layout, or phenomenological description of a Mall World experience; content is about community verification/authentication and communication methods.

meta.author_theory: Live music can serve as a safer (harder-to-fake) verification/authentication process compared to text, and can help express ideas that are too ineffable to communicate purely with text.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no dream phenomenology; only community/meta content about Discord verification using live music and limitations of text communication.
